note: Single source of the BG02 camera and walk paths for render_v06.js (v05 had the same numbers twice in render.js: the camera object on line 6 and the world() lambdas on line 50). Design values are 1080-wide; the renderer derives the 720x1280 values exactly as v05 did (F = 1100*720/1080, horizon = 675*720/1080).

enter.note: front view, walking toward the camera from just inside the door plane (v05 front start_z)

pass.note: side view, walking toward screen left (v05 side start_x, z)

exit_v05.note: v05 rear start_z. Only for --mode v05; v06 derives the exit origin from the stand point after the turn (render_v06.js exitOrigin)
